string-array.name: help_input_lines
string-array.item: Tap the field at the bottom to type, then tap Send.
Hold the field to talk, release to finish; slide up while holding to cancel.
Voice needs the speech pack from Settings → Speech pack. Recognition runs on the phone, offline, in Chinese and English.

string-array.name: help_tasks_lines
string-array.item: Swipe left: done. Swipe left on a completed task: restore.
Swipe right: delete, with Undo at the bottom.
Spoken tasks keep their recording; tap ▶ to play it. Tasks from one sentence share one recording.
Settings → Recordings deletes the recordings of all completed tasks; the tasks stay.
Tap a task to give it a topic by hand. Topics (menu → Topics) colour tasks automatically by their keywords; nothing is split into separate lists.

Home-screen widget: adds tasks without opening the app. Tap the bar for a small panel to type in (or hold its field to talk); tap the icon to talk right away. Shrink it to one cell and it becomes just the icon — it stops when you finish, or tap ■. A widget itself cannot be long-pressed; Android keeps that for moving it.

string-array.name: help_time_lines
string-array.item: Dates: today, tomorrow, Friday, next Wednesday, Nov 5, end of the month, in 3 days, within 2 weeks.
Times: 3pm, 3:30, 15:30, tonight, this evening, noon.
“by / before” sets a deadline; “after / from” sets a start.
Reminders: “remind me 30 minutes before”, “remind me a day before”.
Several tasks in one sentence: separate them with “and also” or “then”.
In Chinese: 明天、后天、周五、下周三、11月5号、月底、国庆前、下午三点、下班前、之前 / 之后、提前半小时提醒我.

string-array.name: help_confirm_lines
string-array.item: Before saving you see what was understood; title, date and time can all be changed.
Anything uncertain is marked, with alternatives one tap away.
Removed fillers, self-corrections and proper-noun fixes are listed at the top; Revert restores what you said.

string-array.name: help_vocab_lines
string-array.item: Add company names, people and places under Proper nouns in the menu; same-sounding Chinese characters are corrected to your spelling.
For English names or words that don\'t sound like their spelling, add what they are often heard as.
If you fix a name by hand on the confirmation card, you\'ll be offered to add it.

string-array.name: help_reminders_lines
string-array.item: Tasks with a time: reminded 30 minutes before (adjustable) and when due.
Tasks with only a date: reminded at 20:00 the day before and 9:00 on the day.
Notifications have Done and Remind in 1 hour.
For reminders on time, turn on everything under Settings → Reminder permissions; many Chinese phones also need Autostart.

string-array.name: help_updates_lines
string-array.item: The app checks for updates once a day, or from Settings → Updates.
The network is only used to check for updates and download the speech pack.
